# Footprints of the JLC parts library (EasyEDA), read 2026-11-10 from the part pages of JLC
# (jlcpcb.com/partdetail/<LCSC number>, section "PCB Footprint"): for every part that is not a plain chip
# resistor or capacitor, the origin of the footprint (the point JLC puts at Mid X, Mid Y) and its pads.
# tools/fab.py lays these pads over the pads of the board and takes rotation and position from the fit.
# Format: LCSC number, "O" x,y of the origin, "P" pads as number,x,y; units of the library (10 mil), y down.
# Long rows of pins are given by their end pins only. Pad numbers follow the board where the library numbers
# differ: C93157 (switch, library 1 2 / 3 4, board 1 1 / 2 2), C151075 (one fuse clip, any pad: x).
